root_cause: Existing parallel engineering fabric validated shared main epoch, changed paths, dependent tests and writer conflicts, but innovation/model-upgrade proposals did not require an explicit source/baseline/replay/shadow/canary/rollback envelope before autonomous candidate planning.

observed_evidence.caveat: This is planning preflight only; metadata are not independently verified provider evidence. No business value or performance uplift has been demonstrated.

fix: Reuse the existing parallel-engineering fabric to evaluate innovation/model_upgrade/new_technique/autonomous_optimization packets before wave admission. Require exact canonical writer lease and captured SHA, 30-day source observation, baseline >=30 observations, executable canonical replay paths, shadow/control/canary/rollback plans, and tenant/CI/CodeQL/provider/cost security intent. Surface seven stage statuses and forbid claims of external verification or production promotion from self-authored metadata. Ordinary work packages retain the existing protected path.
failed_approaches: Treat a source link or positive hypothesis as proven outcomes
Let an autonomous model upgrade run without existing experiment controls
Mark proposed shadow and canary plans as completed
Duplicate schedulers or weaken protected CI to ship innovations faster
prevention_rule: Every explicit innovation/model upgrade/new technique/autonomous optimization work package must pass structure gate before entering the parallel development wave. Stage 1 is pre-registered, not provider-verified; replay, shadow, canary, protected release, outcome readback and canonical Brain writeback remain separate proof stages. No producer can self-approve a cost/permission/tenant boundary or mark customer outcomes proven without the original providers.

invariants: new technique label with missing quality packet is blocked
candidate with canonical owner + controls may plan nonproduction replay only
false or stale source, out-of-range baseline, missing replay/control, risk high, or missing security/tenant protections fail closed
seven distinct stages never claim actual execution, promotion or business impact
existing unlabelled/legacy work packets keep original protected planning
no duplicate scheduler, agent, skill registry or automatic cost escalation

terminal_rule: Protected required checks and CodeQL on immutable candidate HEAD; merge only under branch protection, verify source on main, skill projection and existing Brain learning. Post-merge proof of admitted candidate planning does not prove production safety or customer revenue.
